E1293

lint `{name}` (`{code}`) is denied by policy: {what}

What

lint `{name}` (`{code}`) is denied by policy: {what}

Why

{why}. this team's `policy.lints.deny` in `package.jet` turns this warning into a build failure (D-LINTPOLICY1 — the override law); it stays a warning everywhere `package.jet` doesn't opt in. The listed lint name matches.

Fix

use the underlying lint fix ({fix}), or remove `{name}` from `policy.lints.deny` if this team no longer wants the wall.
